svg.title: Cloud-OpsBench — all six metrics across the published baseline field
svg.desc: Matrix of six metrics for ten published bare models and ours. Baselines weighted over 550 Online Boutique and 204 Train-Ticket cases; ours from the full 754-case run. Ours is highest on every metric.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rows sorted by JRA. CA / FA / JRA are hit rates; MC / EOC / ECR are means. Values printed; colour is a redundant encoding.
